heading.en: How much of one vector lies along another?
heading.kn: ಒಂದು ಸದಿಶದ ಎಷ್ಟು ಭಾಗ ಇನ್ನೊಂದರ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿದೆ?

hook.en: Pull a trolley with a rope at an angle. Only the part of your pull along the ground moves it. The dot product measures exactly that, and work done in physics is a dot product.
hook.kn: ಹಗ್ಗದಿಂದ ಕೋನದಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರಾಲಿಯನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ. ನೆಲದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಭಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅದನ್ನು ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಿಂದು ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ ಅದನ್ನೇ ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಕೆಲಸ ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ.

objectives.en: Find the scalar product in two ways
Find the angle between two vectors and test perpendicularity
Find the projection of one vector on another

narration.en: Pull a trolley with a rope at an angle. Only the part of your pull along the ground moves it. The dot product measures exactly that, and work done in physics is a dot product.
narration.kn: ಹಗ್ಗದಿಂದ ಕೋನದಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರಾಲಿಯನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ. ನೆಲದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಭಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅದನ್ನು ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಿಂದು ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ ಅದನ್ನೇ ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಕೆಲಸ ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ.

body.en: $\vec a\cdot\vec b = |\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta$, a scalar. In components, $\vec a\cdot\vec b = a_1b_1 + a_2b_2 + a_3b_3$. Non-zero vectors are perpendicular exactly when $\vec a\cdot\vec b = 0$. Also $\hat i\cdot\hat i = 1$, $\hat i\cdot\hat j = 0$, and $\vec a\cdot\vec a = |\vec a|^2$.
body.kn: a·b = |a||b|cos θ, ಇದು ಅದಿಶ. ಘಟಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃. a·b = 0 ಆದರೆ ಸದಿಶಗಳು ಲಂಬ. a·a = |a|².

narration.en: The dot product is the product of the lengths times the cosine of the angle between them, and the answer is a number. In components, multiply matching components and add. If the dot product is zero, the vectors are perpendicular.
narration.kn: a·b = |a||b|cos θ, ಇದು ಅದಿಶ. ಘಟಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃. a·b = 0 ಆದರೆ ಸದಿಶಗಳು ಲಂಬ. a·a = |a|².

blocks.formula: \vec a\cdot\vec b = |\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta = a_1b_1 + a_2b_2 + a_3b_3

narration.en: The teacher draws the projection of one vector on another, writes the dot product two ways and finds an angle.

say.en: Two vectors a and b with an angle theta between them. Drop a perpendicular from the tip of a onto b.
The orange length is the projection of a on b. The dot product is the length of b times this projection.
If the dot product is zero, the vectors are perpendicular. If it is negative, the angle is obtuse.
Example: a = i plus j minus k and b = i minus j plus k. a dot b = 1 minus 1 minus 1 = minus 1. Both lengths are root 3.
So cos theta is minus one third, and the angle is obtuse: theta = cos inverse of minus one third.

body.en: The angle between two vectors is given by $\cos\theta = \frac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}$. The projection of $\vec a$ on $\vec b$ is $\frac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec b|} = \vec a\cdot\hat b$: the length of the shadow of $\vec a$ along $\vec b$.
body.kn: ಕೋನ: cos θ = a·b/(|a||b|). b ಮೇಲೆ a ಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ = a·b/|b|: b ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ a ಯ ನೆರಳಿನ ಉದ್ದ.

points.en: Projection of a⃗ on b⃗: divide by |b⃗|, not |a⃗|
Negative projection means the angle is obtuse

narration.en: Rearrange the definition to get the cosine of the angle. The projection of a on b is a dot b divided by the length of b: think of it as the shadow of a falling on the line of b.
narration.kn: ಕೋನ: cos θ = a·b/(|a||b|). b ಮೇಲೆ a ಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ = a·b/|b|: b ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ a ಯ ನೆರಳಿನ ಉದ್ದ.

caption.en: Vectors a and b with angle θ between them (θ measured from b). Change θ and the lengths and watch a·b and the projection.

narration.en: Move the angle. The dot product is largest when the vectors point the same way, zero at 90 degrees, and negative beyond it.

heading.en: Equal diagonals mean a right angle

body.en: |a⃗ + b⃗| = |a⃗ − b⃗| exactly when a⃗ · b⃗ = 0, because squaring gives |a|² + |b|² ± 2a⃗·b⃗. So if the two diagonals of a parallelogram are equal, it is a rectangle.

narration.en: Equal diagonals mean a right angle. |a⃗ + b⃗| = |a⃗ − b⃗| exactly when a⃗ · b⃗ = 0, because squaring gives |a|² + |b|² ± 2a⃗·b⃗. So if the two diagonals of a parallelogram are equal, it is a rectangle.
Make a = 2i + k j perpendicular to b = 3i − 6j.

prompt.en: Make a = 2i + k j perpendicular to b = 3i − 6j.

hint.en: Perpendicular vectors have a zero dot product.

points.en: a⃗ · b⃗ = |a⃗||b⃗|cos θ = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃.
Non-zero vectors are perpendicular if and only if a⃗ · b⃗ = 0.
points.kn: a·b = 0 ಆದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಶೂನ್ಯೇತರ ಸದಿಶಗಳು ಲಂಬ.

points.en: Projection of a⃗ on b⃗ = a⃗ · b⃗ / |b⃗|.
points.kn: b ಮೇಲೆ a ಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ = a·b/|b|.

narration.en: Recap. a⃗ · b⃗ = |a⃗||b⃗|cos θ = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃. Non-zero vectors are perpendicular if and only if a⃗ · b⃗ = 0. Projection of a⃗ on b⃗ = a⃗ · b⃗ / |b⃗|.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. a·b = |a||b|cos θ = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃. a·b = 0 ಆದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಶೂನ್ಯೇತರ ಸದಿಶಗಳು ಲಂಬ. b ಮೇಲೆ a ಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ = a·b/|b|.
